g.text: Whole graft comparisons retain the joining seam
Three blocks have one expanded bar-bicomodule graph.
(X₁ ⋆ X₂) ⋆ X₃ = X₁ ⋆ (X₂ ⋆ X₃)
⋆ retains each original joining bar.
H⋆ = H₁ ⋆ 1 + I₁Q₁ ⋆ H₂
δH⋆ = 1 − I⋆Q⋆
The full seam differential is part of both objects.
First compare the expanded block graphs
R⋆ = R₁ ⋆ A₂I₂ + I₁′B₁ ⋆ R₂
Then keep the original joining section:
δη = B⋆ s − s′ B₁₂
R = R⋆ s + I⋆′ η
Every higher product core and native mixed core remains.
Final projection paths can still differ
Nonlinear three-block example:
J = P_R H_L
(dJ + Jd)(z) = 1_V
The odd coefficient unary differential is retained.
A common section does not make these projections equal.
Full expanded-seam graft and represented section comparison: Theorem 54.
Original joining term and nonzero path comparison: Exercise 54.
Literal graph and full multicut: Theorems 32, 44; projection paths: 29, 35, 42.
